title: Make Your Face Shine upon Us

questions.question: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face to what upon us?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:1 (ESV): "May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face to shine upon us,"

questions.question: That your way may be known on earth, your saving power among all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:2 (ESV): "that your way may be known on earth, your saving power among all nations."

questions.question: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:3 (ESV): "Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples praise you!"

questions.question: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you judge the peoples with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:4 (ESV): "...for you judge the peoples with equity..."

questions.question: And guide the nations upon what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:4 (ESV): "...and guide the nations upon earth."

questions.question: The earth has yielded its increase; God, our God, shall do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:6 (ESV): "The earth has yielded its increase; God, our God, shall bless us."

questions.question: God shall bless us; let all the ends of the earth do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:7 (ESV): "God shall bless us; let all the ends of the earth fear him!"

questions.question: How many times does "Let the peoples praise you" appear in this Psalm?
Who should sing for joy?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:4 (ESV): "Let the nations be glad and sing for joy,"

questions.question: Why should the nations be glad?
This Psalm is often associated with which blessing?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 echoes the Priestly Blessing from Numbers 6:24-26.

questions.question: What instrument is mentioned in the title?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67 Title: "To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song."

questions.question: The phrase "Selah" occurs how many times in Psalm 67?
questions.explanation: At the end of verse 4 in the ESV.

questions.question: What is the desired result of God blessing us in verse 2?
options: That his way may be known on earth
questions.correctAnswer: That his way may be known on earth
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:2 (ESV): "that your way may be known on earth..."

questions.question: What does the earth yield?
questions.explanation: Psalm 67:6 (ESV): "The earth has yielded its increase;"

key_verse_text: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face to shine upon us, that your way may be known on earth, your saving power among all nations.
